subject: design/e2e-verification-skills-v2
statement: e2e-plan **refuses** on an e2e design doc that is not operator-approved (`prd:e2e-verification/UB-4`), and **refuses** on an approved doc whose scenarios do not each name one exclusively-owned artifact — naming the offending scenarios and projecting zero tasks (`UB-9`, `#DINV-7`). Ownership is a property the design must supply and the review must have seen; a planner that invented it would be assigning work the review never checked, and would own the resulting collisions itself.
